info.description:
# Introduction
This is the documentation for all the API endpoints. You can read more about our API (getting started, authentication, etc) on our [developer page](https://www.chainels.com/developer).

# Authentication
We use the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authenticate requests. Check out [our documentation on OAuth](https://www.chainels.com/developer/oauth) to find out how you can get an access token. There we describe the _Authorization Code_ and _Group Token_ grant (both are labeled `oauth_code` here) and the _Client Credential_ grant (labeled `oauth_client` here)

tags.name: Periodic Reporting Overview
tags.description:
Endpoints related to periodic reporting (e.g. turnover, utility). The design of our periodic reporting module revolves around the concepts of "Schemes", "Periods" and "Reports".
### Periodic reporting scheme
A scheme defines when members need to report and for what. The interval of a scheme defines how often members need to report. Members (e.g. companies, households) could be enrolled in multiple schemes with different intervals or different fields.
### Period
A period is an instance of an interval. Based on the interval defined by the scheme, each period represents a "slot" for which the user must fill in a report.
### Report
A member has one report for each period. This report can be `open`, which means the user must still fill it in for the period. A status of `missed_deadline` means the deadline for the period has passed and the user did not report yet. Once a period has been reported, the status will be `reported` and the `PeriodicReport` resource will contain the data and also meta data such as who reported it and when.
